summary.headline: Mahindra Lifespaces FY26 PAT rose to ₹298 crore from ₹61 crore; Q4 Resi pre-sales ₹1,633 crore; FY27 pre-sales guidance ₹4,500–5,000 crore retained.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 PAT was ₹90 crore versus ₹85 crore a year earlier, and full-year FY26 PAT was ₹298 crore versus ₹61 crore, driven by completions and industrial (IC&IC) leasing. Resi pre-sales were ₹1,633 crore in Q4 and ₹3,405 crore for FY26, with combined Resi and IC pre-sales of about ₹4,120 crore. Eight OCs were planned for FY26; management cited eight achieved, with two more received in early April 2026, and five of eight planned launches happened. Management flagged a slowdown in sales-gallery footfalls tied to the geopolitical situation, though it said sustenance sales in Pune and Bangalore remained robust.

segments.name: Residential
segments.commentary: Q4 pre-sales ₹1,633 crore and FY26 pre-sales ₹3,405 crore; 40% of FY26 sales from sustenance rather than launches. Management said Resi profitability was positive for FY26 after additional OCs.

segments.name: Industrial (IC&IC)
segments.commentary: Strong FY26 leasing with ₹360 crore of new lease revenue in Q4 from Origins Chennai 2A after final approvals in December 2025. Management guides ₹400-500 crore of IC business per year (midpoint ₹500 crore) and PAT of roughly ₹550 crore from this business; no new IC GDV signed in Q4.

guidance_outlook: FY27 Resi pre-sales guidance of ₹4,500-5,000 crore reiterated (pure Resi, excluding industrial); management hopes to exceed it, citing ~₹10,000 crore of launch value including Rainforest's ~₹3,000 crore.

FY27 launches: about ₹10,000 crore, of which ~₹3,000 crore is Rainforest (launched in Q4 FY26) and ~₹7,000 crore from 7-8 further launches; Beacon Hill and Citadel Phase 3 approvals expected this quarter; Mahalakshmi RERA targeted this quarter.

FY27 OCs: eight planned, two already received (Eden Phase 2 on 1 April 2026; Luminare in NCR, OC on 31 March with demand letters slipping into Q1 FY27); four premium and two affordable remain in the plan.
FY27 business development: management guided to more than ₹10,000 crore of GDV addition, with a 60-20-20 split across Mumbai, Pune and Bangalore.
Cash flow projection of about ₹14,510 crore from current, pipeline and Thane projects; Jaipur Resi and Murud not yet included.
Portfolio IRR of about 17% across 26 projects, including affordable projects (affordable close to single digits, in some cases negative).
capex_capacity: Thane land (R-zone, now fully residential): about 7,500 crore GDV; plan of ~6-6.5 million sq ft (2 mn sq ft office, 2 mn sq ft commercial, 4 mn sq ft residential plus retail); first phase launch targeted end-FY26 or early FY27.
Origins Ahmedabad has all approvals; anchor client awaited, with Ahmedabad expected to start this year. Origins Pune land aggregation at 400+ acres (about 500 acres touched); approvals FY27-FY28.
Of six IC locations, three to four are active; OC2A firing, OC2B under aggregation.
Rainforest Phase 1 received RERA (full GDV above ₹12,000 crore); Blossom 60% sold within a week of launch.
Management plans to hold rather than sell Mixed-use assets in Thane, Bhandup/Kanjur and Citadel for annuity; annuity portfolio target of ₹150-200 crore before further commercial capex.
demand_pricing: Management said walk-ins moderated and buyers are deferring decisions due to the geopolitical situation, with footfall slowdown at the Rainforest sales gallery; the gallery opens next week.
Management said the company operates only in mid-premium and premium (not luxury), with luxury defined as Mumbai ₹60,000-70,000 per sq ft and tickets above ₹10 crore showing weaker elasticity.
Sustenance sales in Pune and Bangalore described as robust; Bangalore identified as highest IRR market.
Industrial realisations improved significantly; leasing strong in Jaipur and Chennai, with Japanese customers leading lease revenue.

Q4 gross margin estimated around 6% by an analyst; management said project-level gross margins are upwards of 30% for premium projects, with Phase 1 margins lower than later phases and affordable projects dragging.

qa_highlights.question: Is there upside to FY27 pre-sales guidance of ₹4,500-5,000 crore given launch slippage?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said launch value is about ₹10,000 crore including Rainforest, aims to do well, but is cautious given war-related footfall slowdown; guidance is pure Resi, with industrial on top.

qa_highlights.question: How will business development be split across Mumbai, Pune and Bangalore for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided FY27 BD north of ₹10,000 crore, with a 60-20-20 split across Mumbai, Pune and Bangalore; current GDV is about ₹35,000 crore in Mumbai and ₹5,000 crore each in the other two cities.

qa_highlights.question: Is BD a cushion or growth engine, and how does velocity affect launches?
qa_highlights.answer: Both; society redevelopments are slow (2 years, 1.5 years, and ~400 days for the third), so more projects provide cushion. Management would consider deferring launches if velocity slowed, but first wants to deliver FY27 sales.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Ahmedabad and Pune IC timing?
qa_highlights.answer: Ahmedabad has approvals and is expected to start this year pending an anchor client; Pune land aggregation is ongoing with approvals expected FY27-FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What is the annuity strategy and rental income target?
qa_highlights.answer: Company will hold assets rather than strata-sell; target of ₹150-200 crore annuity before further commercial capex, with the ₹300 crore four-to-five-year figure not expected.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company re-enter Gurgaon or expand to another city?
qa_highlights.answer: Management prioritises deepening existing three markets for about two years; a new geography would be considered once a path to ₹5,000-7,000 crore sales exists, with Chennai cited as a candidate.

risks_watch: Geopolitical and war-related slowdown in walk-ins and decision-making; management said impact is too early to quantify and luxury-segment impact is greater.
Launch timing risk: Beacon Hill, Citadel Phase 3 and Mahalakshmi approvals and RERA are targeted this quarter.
Cost inflation from energy prices, new labour codes, and price locking early; affordable projects with single-digit or negative margins.
Bangalore inventory is scarce (about ₹3,000 crore combined) and new deals are not yet signed; Pune and Ahmedabad IC activation depends on anchor clients.
Thane and Mahalakshmi launch timing and FY27 OC recognition (Eden Phase 2, Luminare slipped into Q1 FY27).
summary.management_tone: Confident on FY27 launch pipeline, PAT trajectory and balance sheet, but cautious on near-term demand, with management saying it is too early to size the war's impact and declining to commit to above-guidance pre-sales. Evasive on exact FY27 revenue recognition and on Thane and Mahalakshmi launch timing.

we have not changed the cost for last 8 quarters.

growth.why: FY27 pure-Resi pre-sales guidance of ₹4,500–5,000 crore reiterated, backed by ~₹10,000 crore FY27 launch pipeline (incl. ~₹3,000 crore Rainforest already launched) and 8 planned OCs (2 done), but no revenue growth % given and demand softening from footfall slowdown due to geopolitical situation.
